payload.name: Extract photo-shared object descriptions
payload.description: When a user indicates sharing a picture and then gives a short descriptive phrase about the shown item, extract the description as a memory.
content: When a user shares a photo and then gives a brief evaluative description of the shown item (e.g., an adjective phrase), preserve that description in memory.
Resolve the item from context (including pronouns) and store the description as a state or preference memory.

solves: When a user shares a photo and then describes the pictured object with a short adjective phrase, the construction stage may skip extraction because the sentence is elliptical and the object is only implied. This rule ensures such photo-plus-description statements are captured as memory candidates, so later questions about the user's description can be answered.
